en: The postcard features a sepia-toned, hand-colored photographic image of a young Chinese girl dressed in traditional attire, including a headpiece with dangling ornaments and a loose, ornate robe. The background is plain and light, focusing attention on the subject. At the bottom, there is printed text identifying the image, publisher, place of publication, location of printing, and postcard number.
